project.name: Lyraform
project.summary: Experimental graph-, contract-, and flow-oriented language and system-architecture project, formerly Flowcore

current_milestone.name: Reusable native Flow compiler chain
current_milestone.result: The reusable chain is verified for its admitted bounded surface: installed compiler tools compile newly supported source, exact evidence authorization and native/TinyVM boundary behavior pass; broader language and backend parity remain unfinished.

verified_capabilities: Deterministic and independently validated TinyVM executable artifacts
Equivalent portable switch and GCC calculated-goto TinyVM engines
Shared captured backend-neutral lowering consumed by LLVM and TinyVM
Provider-free scalar execution parity for the currently admitted surface
Exact governed host-call admission with unsupported tuples inventoried
Name-only llvm-host and tinyvm-portable target-policy builds without implicit fallback
One shared tokenizer/document scalar classifier executed through LLVM and both TinyVM engines
Validated dependency graph for remaining Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3 bootstrap work
Exact generated contract and live-provider evidence authorization
Native scalar source graphs with durable FIFO scheduling and fresh receiver frames
Flow-owned paging with injectable batch input, terminal and output providers
Installed newly named gettid acceptance with unchanged compiler binaries
Verified packed integer aggregate payloads and bounded aggregate streams through LLVM and TinyVM

verification.clang_superbuild: fresh Clang 18.1.3 ASan/UBSan pass (106/106) with detect_leaks=0 ptrace exclusion
verification.gcc_asan_ubsan: not run as a coherent matrix

explicit_non_claims: Arbitrary target architectures are not implemented
Native graph execution covers the verified Point aggregate and bounded streams; broader aggregate/runtime activation semantics remain open
The pager renders after a bounded input batch, not continuously
Provider evidence is checked at binding time and does not pin future loads

may_update: GitHub repository description and topics when separately authorized
